rows.name: Bank credit – scheduled commercial banks
rows.source: RBI – Handbook Table 167 (Form A, to Mar 2026) + WSS Table 4 (month-end, Apr 2026 on)
rows.notes: Outstanding. Last reporting Friday of month until Nov 2025, last day of month thereafter. Includes the HDFC–HDFC Bank merger from 1 Jul 2023.

rows.name: Bank credit growth (y/y)
rows.source: Derived here from RBI levels (matches WSS 'Year-on-Year' growth)
rows.notes: Jul 2023–Jun 2024 inflated by the HDFC merger (RBI also publishes ex-merger figures). Dec 2025–Nov 2026: compared with the corresponding reporting Friday a year earlier (RBI note on the change of reporting date); from Dec 2026 month-end to month-end.

rows.name: Aggregate deposits – scheduled commercial banks
rows.source: RBI – Handbook Table 167 (Form A, to Mar 2026) + WSS Table 4 (month-end, Apr 2026 on)
rows.notes: Outstanding. Last reporting Friday of month until Nov 2025, last day of month thereafter. Includes the HDFC–HDFC Bank merger from 1 Jul 2023.

rows.name: Aggregate deposits growth (y/y)
rows.source: Derived here from RBI levels (matches WSS 'Year-on-Year' growth)
rows.notes: Jul 2023–Jun 2024 inflated by the HDFC merger (RBI also publishes ex-merger figures). Dec 2025–Nov 2026: compared with the corresponding reporting Friday a year earlier (RBI note on the change of reporting date); from Dec 2026 month-end to month-end.

rows.name: Credit growth minus deposit growth
rows.source: Derived here from RBI bank credit and deposit levels (Handbook Table 167, WSS Table 4)
rows.notes: Scheduled commercial banks, y/y growth rates, percentage points. A wider gap means credit is growing faster than deposits; it is not a cash shortfall. Dec 2025–Nov 2026 compare a month-end with the corresponding reporting Friday a year earlier, because RBI moved the reporting date from the last reporting Friday to month-end in Dec 2025.

rows.name: Credit growth minus deposit growth, 3-month average
rows.source: Derived here from RBI bank credit and deposit levels (Handbook Table 167, WSS Table 4)
rows.notes: Average of the latest three monthly gaps; months with any gap missing are left out. Dec 2025–Nov 2026 compare a month-end with the corresponding reporting Friday a year earlier, because RBI moved the reporting date from the last reporting Friday to month-end in Dec 2025.

rows.name: Incremental credit–deposit ratio, financial year to date
rows.source: Derived here from RBI bank credit and deposit levels (Handbook Table 167, WSS Table 4)
rows.notes: Change in bank credit since end-March per ₹100 change in deposits since end-March. Not shown while deposits have grown by less than 0.5% of the end-March stock (or fallen), usually April and May. Compare with the same month of the previous financial year.

rows.name: USD/INR – FBIL reference rate (weekly)
rows.source: RBI – Weekly Statistical Supplement, Table 5 'Ratios and Rates'
rows.notes: Rate on the last trading day of the week, per WSS Table 5.

rows.name: Weighted average call money rate (weekly)
rows.source: RBI – Weekly Statistical Supplement, Table 5 'Ratios and Rates'
rows.notes: Operating target of monetary policy.

rows.name: 91-day T-bill primary yield (weekly)
rows.source: RBI – Weekly Statistical Supplement, Table 5 'Ratios and Rates'
rows.notes: Cut-off yield in the week's auction; gaps where no auction.

rows.name: Call money rate, weighted average (daily)
rows.source: RBI press release 'Money Market Operations as on <date>'
rows.notes: Row A.I 'Call Money'. Days with no call trades (weekends, holidays) are left out.

rows.name: Overnight money market rate, weighted average (daily)
rows.source: RBI press release 'Money Market Operations as on <date>'
rows.notes: Row A 'Overnight Segment (I+II+III+IV)': call, triparty repo, market repo and repo in corporate bonds.

rows.name: RBI net liquidity, outstanding including the day's operations
rows.source: RBI press release 'Money Market Operations as on <date>'
rows.notes: Row F. Positive = net injection by RBI, negative = net absorption. Reported on non-trading days too. Net liquidity = Repo + MSF + SLF - Reverse Repo - SDF.

rows.name: Call money rate minus repo rate (daily)
rows.source: RBI press release 'Money Market Operations as on <date>'
rows.notes: Call money weighted average rate minus the policy repo rate in force that day, in basis points. Trading days only.

rows.name: Call money rate minus repo rate, 5-trading-day average
rows.source: RBI press release 'Money Market Operations as on <date>'
rows.notes: Average of the latest five trading days.

rows.name: Weighted average lending rate, fresh rupee loans
rows.source: RBI press release 'Lending and Deposit Rates of Scheduled Commercial Banks' (highlights)
rows.notes: WALR on loans sanctioned in the month. Scheduled commercial banks excluding RRBs and small finance banks.

rows.name: Weighted average lending rate, outstanding rupee loans
rows.source: RBI press release 'Lending and Deposit Rates of Scheduled Commercial Banks' (highlights)
rows.notes: WALR on the whole loan book. Scheduled commercial banks excluding RRBs and small finance banks.

rows.name: Weighted average term deposit rate, fresh deposits
rows.source: RBI press release 'Lending and Deposit Rates of Scheduled Commercial Banks' (highlights)
rows.notes: WADTDR on term deposits raised in the month. Scheduled commercial banks excluding RRBs and small finance banks.

rows.name: Weighted average term deposit rate, outstanding deposits
rows.source: RBI press release 'Lending and Deposit Rates of Scheduled Commercial Banks' (highlights)
rows.notes: WADTDR on the whole term-deposit book. Scheduled commercial banks excluding RRBs and small finance banks.

rows.name: 1-year MCLR, median across banks
rows.source: RBI press release 'Lending and Deposit Rates of Scheduled Commercial Banks' (highlights)
rows.notes: Usually one month later than the WALR/WADTDR in the same release. Scheduled commercial banks excluding RRBs and small finance banks.

rows.name: Market pricing indicator: fresh loan rate minus fresh deposit rate
rows.source: Derived from RBI lending and deposit rates (fresh WALR minus fresh WADTDR)
rows.notes: A market-wide pricing indicator, not a bank's margin: loan mix, funding mix and tenor all affect it.
